site.title: Instagram
site.short_description: Visual discovery — bio link and feed posts for brands and creators.
site.long_description: Instagram bio links appear on profiles. Business and Creator accounts can set one outbound URL. See add a link to your profile.

opportunities.title: Personal profile link
opportunities.description: Use your personal Instagram (Creator or personal) account and put your site in the bio link when available. See add a link to your profile. Good for founders building in public on one handle. Links are typically nofollow.

steps.body: Go to Edit profile on the Instagram account you use as yourself in the app or on web.
steps.title: Open your personal profile

steps.body: Add your website in the link field per Instagram Help, save, and test from a logged-out view.
steps.title: Set the bio link

opportunities.title: Brand profile bio link
opportunities.description: Switch to a Business or Creator account and put your primary URL in the bio link field—see add a link to your Instagram profile. Essential for brand presence even when links are nofollow.

steps.body: Go to Edit profile on your Business or Creator account in the Instagram app or web.
steps.title: Open profile settings

steps.body: Add your website in the designated link field per Instagram Help, save, and test from a logged-out view.
steps.title: Set the bio link
